title: Booking
description: A booking resource that represents a scheduled record on a calendar, including lifecycle state, recurrence context, ownership, and operational metadata.

calendar_id.description: Primary key of the calendar that owns this booking.

sources.description: Upstream or cross-system source references connected to this booking, such as synced provider events or imported records.

parent_booking_id.description: Optional parent booking identifier when this record is derived from another booking.

series_master_booking_id.description: Optional master-series booking identifier for recurring instances or exceptions.

booking_number.description: Human-friendly booking reference for support, invoices, or operator workflows.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the booking.

description.description: Optional long-form notes or business context for the booking.
description.example: Planning session for Q3 roadmap with engineering and product leads.

status_reason.description: Optional human-readable explanation for the current status.
status_reason.example: Approved by the scheduling team after availability review.

type.description: Structural classification of the booking record.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret the booking schedule.

starts_at.description: Inclusive start timestamp of the booking in ISO 8601 format.

ends_at.description: Exclusive end timestamp of the booking in ISO 8601 format.

all_day.description: Whether the booking spans the full local calendar day rather than a time range.

duration_minutes.description: Total booked duration in minutes for faster filtering and reporting.

buffer_before_minutes.description: Optional preparation time reserved immediately before the booking.

buffer_after_minutes.description: Optional wrap-up time reserved immediately after the booking.

assignees.description: Users responsible for owning or operating the booking.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the booking was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the booking was last updated.

lifecycle.description: Audit-style status transition history for the booking. The current top-level status should match the latest lifecycle entry.

notes.description: Internal operational notes that should not necessarily be displayed to end users.
notes.example: Room access code will be shared 15 minutes before the booking starts.

metadata.description: Flexible extension point for provider-specific or domain-specific attributes that do not belong in the core schema.

user_reference.description: Normalized user reference with a resource kind and UUID identifier.

kind.description: Resource kind of the user reference.

id.description: Primary key of the related user.

source_reference.description: External or cross-system source reference linked to the booking.

kind.description: Source kind, such as google_calendar_event, microsoft_graph_event, imported_csv_row, or crm_booking.

provider.description: Name of the upstream provider or source system.

id.description: Stable identifier from the upstream provider.

synced_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful sync for this source reference.

metadata.description: Optional provider-specific attributes related to the source reference.

lifecycle_entry.description: A single status transition recorded in the booking lifecycle.

status.description: Status assigned at this lifecycle transition.

changed_at.description: Timestamp when the status transition occurred.

reason.description: Optional explanation for the status transition.

metadata.description: Optional machine-friendly context for the transition.

location.description: Optional physical or virtual location attached to the booking.

label.description: Short display label for the location.

address.description: Postal address or room details for in-person events.

meeting_url.description: Join URL for a virtual meeting.

recurrence.description: Recurrence rules used when the booking belongs to a repeating series.

interval.description: Number of frequency units between each occurrence.

count.description: Optional maximum number of generated occurrences.

until.description: Optional end boundary for the recurring series.

by_week_days.description: Days of the week used for weekly recurrence patterns.
